Air Force Group C Civilian Offline Form 2026 – Full Details

Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the notification for the Group C (Civilian) posts. This recruitment has been issued for 47 posts. The offline application process for Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 has started on 02 May 2026, and candidates can apply till 01 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 May 2026
  • Last Date : 01 June 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • No Application Fees For All Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
